answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks like a glacier resists cracks: through stake-bonded endorsement. Each established agent may vouch for newcomers, but every vouch locks a slice of the voucher's own earned balance as collateral. If the newcomer is later proven sybil, the collateral is slashed and the voucher's endorsement weight is permanently cut, as irreversibly as a flawed crystal. An attacker minting thousands of opal-bright fake identities must stake real value behind each one, so attack cost grows linearly while honest participants risk only reputation they already hold.
